name: chezable
description: Chezable MVP: shared shell, nine HTML5 stages, Worker API on D1.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply chezable --local -c apps/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs && npm run db:local && wrangler dev -c apps/worker/wrangler.toml --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run budget && npm run smoke && npm run browser && npm run a11y
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply chezable --remote -c apps/worker/wrangler.toml
